consumption.description: Published main-engine speed/consumption table in a broker's 3000 TEU container-vessel charter listing
consumption.accessNote: Public search-indexed table; direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403
consumption.conditions: About figures; clean hull, even keel, deep water, calm conditions up to Beaufort 2; speed through water
limitations: One published example; not a fleet average
Different ship from the generic 3500 TEU assumption
Does not establish accuracy at 12 knots or in weather

additionalConsumptionReferences.description: Published 4222 TEU newbuild main-engine consumption including shaft generator
additionalConsumptionReferences.conditions: 12 m loaded draft, clean hull, even keel, fair weather below Beaufort 2 / Douglas 2, no adverse swell or currents; main engine includes shaft-generator load
units: main-engine metric tonnes per day including shaft generator
limitations: Different vessel and electrical-load allocation from the generic model
Main-engine comparison is not a whole-vessel fuel comparison
Listing gives additional auxiliary consumption dependent on reefer load
Published approximate figures; not measured independent voyage validation or a fleet average

price.limitations: Dated reference only; quantity, credit, delivery timing, specification and bunkering location affect actual price

conclusion: Generic planning model; not validated as a vessel-specific or fleet-wide fuel-cost predictor. Two published ship specifications differ materially in their speed/consumption curves and load allocation. Agreement with either does not establish fleet accuracy. Forecast gaps and excluded costs add uncertainty.
